title: feat: add Recraft vector generation
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `recraft-v4.1-vector` with `recraft-vector`, `recraft-svg`, and `recraft-v4.1-svg` aliases.
- Routes only to OpenRouter's `recraft/recraft-v4.1-vector` endpoint through Recraft, with provider fallbacks disabled.
- Supports text-to-SVG and one reference image, returns real `image/svg+xml`, preserves SVG cache/security headers, exposes `media_type` in OpenAI image responses, and adds the Recraft brand mark.
- Registers it paid-only at price multiplier 1 and $0.08 per output. OpenRouter's synthetic token count is normalized to one fixed image unit because the provider invoice is exactly $0.08 per result.

Validation:
- Gen worker: 32 files / 293 tests passed.
- Enter registry/billing: 3 files / 290 tests passed.
- TypeScript and Biome passed for both workers.
- Local paid E2E: GET alias, cached GET, OpenAI generation, and OpenAI edit all returned valid SVG in 9–15s and billed exactly 0.08 Pollen.
- Capacity: 5/5 succeeded; at 15 and 30 concurrency, capacity overflow returned truthful 429s with zero 5xx/timeouts.

Draft gate: accept/monitor the upstream route's small concurrency ceiling before merge.

gist.headline: The hive draws vectors
gist.blurb: A new bee in the garden draws SVGs instead of pixels. Recraft Vector now turns prompts and a reference image into clean, real vector artwork.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only `recraft-v4.1-vector` image model, with `recraft-vector`, `recraft-svg`, and `recraft-v4.1-svg` aliases, for text-to-SVG and single-reference-image generation through Recraft on OpenRouter at 0.08 Pollen per output.
gist.impact: Developers can now request real `image/svg+xml` from Pollinations image and OpenAI-compatible generation/edit endpoints, with SVG cache and security headers preserved and a fixed one-image billing unit.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Recraft Vector as a cozy pixel-art drafting garden: Polli helps a small CRT monitor robot turn a prompt card and one framed reference picture into a curling SVG vine made of clean vector paths. Include the Recraft brand mark as a small sign or stamp, plus flower pots containing code-plants, to show that the output is genuine scalable SVG rather than a raster image.
